hypotheses.retention: At matched learning rate and updates, frozen-parent KL reduces drift and preserves already-correct decisions
hypotheses.complement: Prefix demonstration and parent KL are complementary; KL alone cannot teach an originally missing opening
hypotheses.plasticity: Parent KL may resist the intended correction when the parent is confidently wrong

retention_direction: KL(current || frozen parent), native legal support only, no padding, equal scene weights
sequence: Audited engine replay from normal opening; both models independently rebuild own-seat history from their first decision; no cached cross-checkpoint RNN
evaluation: Variant 0 learning curves and autonomous opening/Halq/Bulb/battle rollouts; all three development variants and original synthetic roots at endpoint, two repeats; independent engine audit
success_gate: Require all three variants at opening and later roots; retain parent-solved battle/synthetic roots; separately report teacher loss, mean/max parent KL and top1 agreement
selection: No checkpoint promotion, automatic PPO continuation or post-hoc update selection; report all four fixed endpoints including failures
stop: Nonfinite update, runtime/input drift, sequence parity failure, invalid engine record or budget exhaustion
scope: Two existing development families only; no unseen-family, global retention or playing-strength claim
reference: MirrorForce sky_specialize.py frozen-parent KL; command weighting and its optimizer clipping are not imported into this single-factor comparison
